title: Brush: a stroke that crosses itself paints a HOLE at the crossing (Flash 8 self-unions); sharp corners thin/notch the ribbon
description:
VERIFIED with repro. Flash 8's brush paints a solid FILL — the nib swept along the path; overlapping the same stroke self-unions into one seamless fill. Ours punches a hole wherever the stroke crosses itself.

ROOT CAUSE (two layers):
1. StageArea.tsx brushPointsToShape (packages/authoring-ui/src/StageArea.tsx:433-530) builds the ribbon as ONE closed outline polygon (forward offsets + reversed backward offsets + caps). When the stroke path crosses itself the outline self-intersects and the crossing region is wound TWICE.
2. buildArrangementFromShapes' fill sampling (packages/core/src/engine/planar/build.ts:94-114) tests each region with even-odd pointInPolygon (query.ts:166-178): the doubly-wound crossing region reads as OUTSIDE the ribbon -> the face resolves to fill=null -> a hole in the committed stroke. clipBrushStroke's pointInShapeFill guard (engine/planar/brushpaint.ts:110-118) is even-odd too, so non-Normal paint modes drop those sub-faces the same way.

REPRO (confirmed on origin/main b4430b6): polyline going right along y=50 then looping up and back DOWN through itself at x=60, width 16, run through buildArrangementFromShapes([ribbon]) -> locateFace at the crossing (60,50) returns fill=null (hole); a single-covered point (20,50) returns the fill. Drawing any loop/cursive letter with the brush shows the hole on stage and in the published SWF.

ALSO WRONG AT CORNERS (same construction): per-point averaged-normal offsets (StageArea.tsx:462-480) narrow the ribbon at a corner by cos(theta/2) (no miter/round-join compensation) and produce a bowtie self-intersection on hairpins -> even-odd notches/missing wedges at sharp turns. Flash 8 keeps constant width with round joins.

SUGGESTED FIX: emit the brush stamp as the eraser does (engine/planar/eraser.ts:392-401 buildEraserStamp): one disk per sample + a bridging capsule per segment, MULTIPLE overlapping simple convex loops all carrying the same fill — assignFaceFillsBySampling's last-covering-wins is an exact union over simple loops (this is precisely how task 1327 fixed the same even-odd defect for the eraser). Read-back then dissolves the interior seams into one silhouette (same-color union). This fixes self-crossing, hairpins, corner thinning, and round caps in one construction; a square nib keeps square stamps. Alternatively make the region sampling nonzero-winding — but the stamp-union fix is local to the brush and provably safe.

NOTE: engine/brushtool.ts addBrushStroke is a parallel legacy ribbon builder (butt caps, no nib shape, plain append bypassing merge) exported but unused by the product draw path — consolidate or delete while in here.

ACCEPTANCE: unit test — brush stroke whose path crosses itself commits with the crossing region FILLED (locateFace/winding parity at the crossing point); hairpin turn produces no interior null-fill face; existing brush-paintmode + merge oracle tests pass. Ideally add a merge-drawing-oracle case (self-crossing stroke renders identically stage vs Ruffle, no hole).

Related: 1260 (round tip, done), 1327 (eraser stamp union), 1421 (paint modes). Found by brush/eraser Flash-8 fidelity audit.
